C1600.title: Mirai Botnet Leverages IoT Devices for DDoS Attacks
C1600.summary: In 2016, Mirai used infected IoT devices to form a botnet and launched large-scale DDoS attacks through central command servers, causing severe attacks against sites such as KrebsOnSecurity. Claims about attacks on DNS infrastructure, widespread network paralysis in Europe and North America, or 110 million US dollars in economic losses should be supported by authoritative Dyn DNS attack and loss-estimate sources.
